ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - SysmonEnte Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of SysmonEnte, a tool to attack the integrity of Sysmon Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, GrantedAccess, SourceImage, CallTrace

sequences.query: (((TargetImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Sysmon\\\.exe.*") OR TargetImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Sysmon64\\\.exe.*")) AND GrantedAccess = "0x1400") AND  NOT ((SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*")) OR (SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Platform\\\\.*") AND SourceImage = RGX("\\\\MsMpEng\\\.exe$")))) OR CallTrace = "Ente"
